authentication_notes: /auth/* endpoints are for login/logout and profile retrieval; they themselves require auth (except login which sets session).
/citizens/* endpoints require citizen authentication after login or registration+email verification.
/internal/* endpoints require internal user authentication with appropriate roles.
/reports/map and /reports/getById/{id} are public and do not require authentication.
/categories is public and does not require authentication.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /citizens/register (or POST /auth/citizens/login) must precede GET/PATCH /citizens/me.
POST /files/upload must precede PATCH /citizens/me if accountPhoto is provided.
DELETE /files/temp/{fileId} depends on prior POST /files/upload to obtain fileId.
POST /admin/internal-users creates resources that can be referenced by PUT /admin/internal-users/{id}.
GET /admin/internal-users provides list of users for role management or verification before updating via PUT.
POST /email-verification/verify must succeed before citizen can fully authenticate and access /citizens/* endpoints.
POST /citizens/report creates reports that are then managed via /internal/reports/* endpoints based on user roles.
PATCH /internal/reports/{id} depends on prior creation of report (via POST /citizens/report) and assignment logic.
PATCH /internal/reports/{id}/delegate depends on report being in 'Assigned' status and user having technical officer role.
POST /citizens/register -> GET /citizens/me: Citizen must be registered and authenticated before accessing their profile.
POST /files/upload -> PATCH /citizens/me: File upload provides temporary file path used in profile update.
POST /files/upload -> DELETE /files/temp/{fileId}: File ID from upload is required to delete temporary file.
POST /admin/internal-users -> PUT /admin/internal-users/{id}: User must exist before updating their data.
GET /admin/internal-users -> PUT /admin/internal-users/{id}: Listing users helps identify valid IDs for updates.
POST /email-verification/verify -> GET /citizens/me: Email verification completes citizen authentication required for profile access.
POST /citizens/report -> PATCH /internal/reports/{id}: Report must be created before its status can be updated.
POST /citizens/report -> GET /internal/reports/assigned: Reports are assigned after creation and must exist to be listed.
PATCH /internal/reports/{id} -> PATCH /internal/reports/{id}/delegate: Delegation can only occur after report is assigned and user has appropriate role.

risks: PUT /admin/internal-users/{id} allows overwriting roles; accidental omission of required companyId for External Maintainer role could cause validation error.
PATCH /internal/reports/{id} enforces strict status transitions; invalid state changes will return 400/403.
POST /citizens/report requires authentication but does not specify which user types can create reports; potential access control ambiguity.
DELETE /files/temp/{fileId} accepts UUID format; if fileId is reused or leaked, unintended deletion could occur.
GET /internal/reports/assigned returns reports for both technical staff and external maintainers; role-based filtering must be enforced server-side to prevent data leakage.
POST /email-verification/resend has rate limit but no explicit backoff guidance in documentation; clients may need to implement exponential backoff.
